observation.command:
ls /root/.local/share/fnm/node-versions/v20.11.0/installation/bin/
# make node/npm/npx globally available
for b in node npm npx; do ln -sf /root/.local/share/fnm/node-versions/v20.11.0/installation/bin/$b /usr/local/bin/$b; done
cat > /etc/profile.d/rvm-fnm.sh <<'EOF'
export PATH=/root/.local/share/fnm/node-versions/v20.11.0/installation/bin:$PATH
source /usr/local/rvm/scripts/rvm
EOF
node -v; npm -v; ruby -v
